native_owners: one sequential owner for each condition; no wall idle loop
schedule: Existing PersistentService.restore_transport/perform and QueueDB admission, each request at the previous safe operation boundary. No Runtime.advance shortcut, CPU-based catchup or display-driven native ticks.
fixed_criterion: Same N/tick, exact whole RAW/clocks, native next_event_id/sequence/phase, channels, pending and native receipts. Report documentary identity/owner epoch differences separately, not as physical errors.
costs: Whole owned worker process plus capture_seconds/capture_count. Not electrical energy. Difference includes view serialization and copies, not Native intelligence.
interpretation_limit: Native fixed-tick test only. Does not prove zero host cost or absence of wall-time effects on a separately coupled external simulator.
